name: ExperienceOps – UAE
description:
Find real operating small and medium-sized businesses in the United Arab Emirates that are plausible early customers for ExperienceOps.

ExperienceOps is a booking management and business operations platform for businesses that sell activities, sessions, classes, services, appointments, or time-based rentals.

Commercial goal: identify prospects for personalized outbound email and acquire paying customers. Prefer relevance, evidence, and contactability over lead volume.

Focus on Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Al Ain.
researchInstructions:
OBJECTIVE
Find real, operating SMB experience businesses in the United Arab Emirates for ExperienceOps outbound email.
Prefer fewer well-qualified leads over hundreds of weak leads.
Do not invent business details, contacts, booking problems, or software usage.
Search by emirate and city (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Al Ain), not as one undifferentiated UAE search.

APPROVED INDUSTRIES ONLY
1. Escape rooms and escape game operators
2. Archery clubs and archery ranges
3. Pottery studios and art studios with bookable workshops, classes, or private events
4. Kayak and canoe rental businesses
5. Climbing gyms and bouldering gyms
6. Photography studios offering studio bookings or equipment rentals
7. Sailing centers, sailing instruction businesses, and dive centers
8. Go-kart tracks and karting venues
9. Event equipment rental businesses
10. Bicycle rental businesses and bicycle workshops offering repair appointments

REJECT / EXCLUDE
K-12 schools, universities, colleges, school districts, education directories
Language schools, tutoring centers, general education listing sites
Horse riding / horse stables
Dog daycare / pet boarding
Shooting ranges / firearms businesses
Gaming centers / gaming cafes
Travel agencies without owned relevant facilities or services
Software vendors, booking platforms, lead-gen sites, directory sites presented as prospects
Permanently closed or unverifiable businesses
A legitimate prospect must be the actual operator of the activity, facility, service, or rental inventory.

IDEAL CUSTOMER PROFILE
Prioritize operational complexity beyond a single appointment calendar:
Multiple bookable rooms, lanes, studios, facilities, or rental assets
Group reservations or capacity-based sessions
Multiple instructors or staff
Several activity, service, or rental packages
Rental pickup/return scheduling
Equipment maintenance or turnaround
Private events, corporate bookings, or recurring workshops
Multiple locations or a relatively large independent operation
Evidence of booking coordination via phone, email, or messaging
Prefer independent SMB operators where an owner or GM may be reachable.
Do not assume manual processes exist simply because the business is small.

SEARCH STRATEGY
Search by industry and emirate/city. Use phrases such as:
Escape room booking Dubai
Pottery studio workshops Abu Dhabi
Kayak rental reservations Dubai
Climbing gym classes Sharjah
Photography studio rental Dubai
Dive center courses Abu Dhabi
Go-kart group events Dubai
Event equipment rental UAE
Bicycle rental reservations Dubai
Bicycle repair appointments Abu Dhabi
Also search Arabic-relevant local listings when useful, but keep the prospect as an actual operating business.
Avoid duplicates, generic directories as prospects, and treating branches as separate leads unless independently operated.

SOURCE REQUIREMENTS
Every prospect needs a source URL proving existence and relevant activity.
Preferred: official website/service/booking page, contact page, official social profile, reputable listing, public decision-maker profile.
Record actual source URL and evidence found.
Never invent names, websites, emails, phones, WhatsApp, titles, booking functionality, company size, or tech usage.
Distinguish confirmed vs inferred vs unknown.

CONTACTABILITY
Prioritize publicly listed business emails verified against an official or reliable source.
Collect when available: business email, contact page, phone, owner/founder/GM name, LinkedIn or official social.
Do not guess emails or mark unverified emails as verified.
No email = secondary/not email-ready.

SCORING (0-100)
Industry and operating-business fit: 25
Booking/scheduling/rental complexity: 25
Evidence of relevant operational needs: 20
Contactability and decision-maker access: 20
Business identity and source reliability: 10
HIGH 75-100: strong fit, credible complexity, reliable sources, good contactability
MEDIUM 50-74: relevant operator, limited complexity/needs/contact evidence
LOW/REJECT below 50: weak fit, insufficient evidence, unreliable identity
Reject excluded industries regardless of score.
Do not award points for evidence not found.

QUALIFICATION RULES
isQualified=true only for HIGH fits that are real operators in approved industries.
MEDIUM fits should usually be needsReview=true, isQualified=false.
Schools, universities, directories, and vendors: isRelevant=false, reject.
Summary must briefly state fit reason, evidence found, and key missing information.
